title: On the universality of multiexcisive functors
summary: We provide a multiplicative classification of polynomial endofunctors on spectra in terms of their Mackey functors of cross--effects. More precisely, we prove that various categories of multivariable excisive functors from spectra to spectra are symmetric monoidally equivalent to the corresponding variants of spectral Mackey functors. The symmetric monoidal structures appearing here are the Day convolutions on both sides, and the Mackey functors we consider involve variations on the category of finite sets and surjections.
